subject: MAP: Performance run & close timeline — DataCo benchmarking windows and results
messages:

Subject: MAP kickoff: performance run booking + test access needs

Hi Priya / Ahmed —

Thanks again for the demo this week. Per our mutual action plan (attached) we have two short items to close before contract signature: 1) final perf pass (latency/throughput/TTFT) in your test env, and 2) a 24‑hour load window to validate concurrency and autoscaling behavior.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm a single 3‑hour window next week where we can run ramped load (we suggest Tue 2026‑08‑03 02:00–05:00 UTC).
- You provision a read‑only test key and a small test account (API key + sandbox GUID) that maps to your staging project.
- Karthik will share the exact load profile and runner config (JMeter + Redwood load harness).

I attached the MAP PDF with timelines and acceptance criteria. Goal: have perf report and signoff by EOD Thu 2026‑08‑05 so we can finalize PO and start Dedicated capacity onboarding the week after.

Attachments: dataco_map_v1.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — looking forward to locking the window.

—

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 06:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: performance run booking + test access needs

Ahmed / team —

Thanks — quick details from the Redwood side so SREs can prep:
- Load profile (ramped): 0→100→500→1000 concurrent connections in 30m / 60m / 60m / 30m segments. Peak sustained concurrency target: 1000.
- Expected throughput: ~1200 tokens/sec at peak for the 8k context model (our runner reports tokens/sec reliably).
- TTFT (time to first token) SLOs we will measure: median ≤ 90ms, p95 ≤ 250ms for cached warm paths; median ≤ 250ms, p95 ≤ 600ms for cold start on cold KV cache.
- We'll run two passes: cache-enabled (default) and cache-disabled to surface worst‑case.
- Artifacts we'll produce: dataco_bench_results_summary.csv (per‑run metrics), per‑request traces (zip), and a short slide with conclusions.

Credentials: Vanessa — once Ahmed posts the staging API key, we'll validate and post the runner config. Please include a staging GUID and a sandbox dataset pointer (we only need synthetic queries but your quota limits must allow the run).

Runner config (summary):
- Tool: redwood-load (internal runner v0.9.3) + JMeter hooks
- Seed prompts: 500 unique prompts from your eval set (we'll rotate)
- Max seq len: 4096 tokens

I'll be on the call during the run and will share realtime dashboards.

—
Karthik Iyer
Benchmarking Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@dataco.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ahmed Khan <ahmed.khan@dataco.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: performance run booking + test access needs — results & acceptance

Hi all —

Quick summary from the runs we executed this morning (attached CSV with per‑run metrics). We ran two full passes per plan: cache‑enabled, then cache‑disabled. Key outcomes:

Cache‑enabled (representative):
- Peak concurrency reached: 1,020
- Average throughput at peak: 1,180 tokens/sec
- TTFT median: 82ms; TTFT p95: 230ms
- Error rate (5xx + timeouts): 0.12%

Cache‑disabled (worst‑case):
- Peak concurrency reached: 980
- Average throughput at peak: 910 tokens/sec
- TTFT median: 210ms; TTFT p95: 520ms
- Error rate: 0.45% (mostly timeouts during the 60m ramp)

Acceptance judgement vs MAP criteria:
- Latency & TTFT: pass for cache‑enabled; marginal for cache‑disabled p95 (we recommend minor knob tuning on token batching).
- Throughput: pass — linear scaling up to 1k concurrency within expected windows.
- Reliability: pass for production readiness with recommended retry/backoff on client side for short timeouts.

Next steps to close the MAP and proceed to PO:
1) Redwood to share the final perf slide deck and CSV (attached).
2) DataCo to confirm acceptance or list blockers by EOD Thu 2026‑08‑05.
3) We will prepare the Dedicated onboarding checklist once acceptance received.

Attachments: dataco_bench_results_summary.csv (CSV)

Thanks everyone — great collaboration. Happy to walk through the dashboards if you want a 30m wrap call.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0124
